name: add-bookkeeping-only-ci-fast-lane
title: Add a bookkeeping-only CI fast lane
description: Reduce redundant CI cost and merge latency for exact-head finish-work task/archive/journal successors without weakening branch protection, metadata validation, or fail-closed full-CI behavior.
creator: sdelmas
notes: Implemented the prior-head classifier, canonical bookkeeping validation lane, mode-strict CI Result aggregate, full-only auto-tag guard, contributor/spec contract, and focused classifier/workflow tests. The reviewed PR #270 head was green and review-clean, but its exact-head finish-work receipt rejected a merge commit in successor history. The validated functional content is being republished byte-identically from current main on the linear recovery branch without rewriting PR #270.
